metadata.scenario: A patient calls to confirm their upcoming appointment for a follow-up consultation regarding their test results. Category: Follow-up.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you? Hi Margaret, this is Eleanor Watson. I'm calling to confirm my upcoming appointment regarding my test results. Hi Eleanor! Of course, let me check your appointment details. It looks like you have a follow-up consultation scheduled for Tuesday at 11 AM. Does that still work for you? Yes, that works for me. But, I wanted to ask if my daughter can join the call? Absolutely, we can arrange for her to be on the call as well. Great! I just want to make sure we can discuss everything related to my recovery. Of course, we will review your test results and any questions you have about your ongoing care. Thank you. I also wanted to ask if there are any new therapies that could help with my recovery? Yes, actually, we have some new options in physical therapy that can aid in post-stroke recovery. That sounds interesting. Can you send information about those therapies to my daughter? Absolutely, I’ll make a note to send that over right after our call. Thank you! I appreciate that. Is there anything else I need before our appointment? Just remember to have your questions ready for the follow-up, and we'll take it from there. Sounds good. I’ll make sure my daughter has questions, too. Perfect! I’ll also follow up with an email confirmation including the therapy details. Thank you, Margaret. I feel much better knowing everything is set. You’re welcome, Eleanor! We're here for you. I might also consider some of the new therapies after our appointment. That sounds like a good plan! I can provide pricing information during our consultation. Perfect, I look forward to it. Great! Have a wonderful day, and we’ll talk soon. Thanks, you too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
